Earthen Core
by Venomous_Viper1 and cole1crc
Features:
 - 3 monuments for each team (Left,Middle, Right)
 - Maximum of 20 players per team
 - Teams are Lime and Orange
 - Map contains gold, iron and diamond

    ~ Bow (Infinity)
    ~ Golden Apple (3)
    ~ Diamond Pickaxe
    ~ Glass (64)
    ~ Oak Log (64)
    ~ Stained Clay (32)
    ~ Baked Potato (64)
    ~ Full Leather Armor

replies.author: Doppelganger_
replies.body:
Some feedback.
  • The lanes seem a bit thin. This encourages just knocking people into the void.
  • The void gap in right and left sides is waaaaaaaay to large 
  • The void gap from the centre lane to the islands I feel is a bit small
  • Perhaps you could make the centre islands a bit bigger
  • Consider reducing the amount of blocks in the spawnkit, because of block spam
  • Also you probably need to add some limits (in the yml) building out to the left and right as u bridging seems a bit too easy
  • 20 to 30 blocks seems a bit too much to the monuments for defenders

replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
[Denied] I'm sorry to say your map has been denied and will not be featured on Avicus. Your map was denied for the following reasons
-Too Narrow -  The paths are far too narrow for balanced pvp, and will most likely end with spawn killing, and/or camping.
-Too similar to Clay Wars - From the team colours, to the use of randomized clay, to the U shape, it bares a very close resemblance to Clay Wars.
- Void Gap - The void gap is massive, meaning the only way through is the middle, which can lead to even more problems, and possibly a stalemate.
Although, the item frame idea was clever, i'll give you that.
